name: David Black
classType: Premium male Terrorist character (Code Box); also a guiding/hidden NPC in Zombie Scenario
factions: AFC (Anti-Force Corps / David's Terrorist-side army, per ZS3 storyline)

profile.occupation: Veteran soldier; former SAS instructor; later leads the AFC army and the rescue effort for Erika

tagline: The SAS instructor who walked out of the Rex basement and never went back to the side he came from.
summary: David Black is a premium Terrorist character obtainable from Code Box and one of the pillars of the Zombie Scenario storyline. A veteran SAS instructor who survived the Rex laboratory explosion, he was so disillusioned by what he saw underground that he accepted the Terrorists' offer of a way out in exchange for helping them obtain confidential documents. His former protege Gerard hunts him, and the two men's relationship - rivalry, then reluctant alliance - runs through Seasons 3 to 9.
story:
**Background (character page).** David is a battle-hardened veteran and a former SAS instructor. He was among the survivors trapped in the laboratory basement during the Rex laboratory explosion. What he witnessed there left him disillusioned, and he agreed to join the Terrorists after they promised to get him out of the lab if he helped them secure confidential documents. Learning that Gerard was pursuing him, he chose to face him on the battlefield in the hope of persuading Gerard to join the Terrorist side.

**Zombie Scenario: Season 3 (Contact / Behind / Threat / Panic Room).** As leader of the AFC army, David receives an urgent request from Norman and, when contact is cut, tracks Norman's last signal to a deserted, sandstorm-swept town that hides the secret entrance to the Vanguard Laboratory. His force breaks into Vanguard headquarters at heavy cost; Erika - whom David treats like a daughter - is wounded. Norman watches through the lab cameras and sends AMP Suits, ostensibly as support. David fortifies the munitions factory as a foothold, but the AMP Suit kidnaps Erika and David rides the lift to the Panic Room to rescue her and take revenge on Norman, unaware of Norman's true intentions. The Panic Room, supposedly the safest place in Vanguard, becomes the worst battlefield of all.

**Zombie Scenario: Season 7 (Rex Labs / Lowdown).** After escaping the Panic Room, Erika suffers unexplained recurring pain. Soi contacts David and tells him to come to the Rex Labs if he wants a cure; they arrive to find the lab already attacked, and follow coordinates found there to a meeting with Gerard rather than Soi. Gerard reveals that Douglas Jacob was the hidden hand behind Dr. Rex and behind Erika's kidnapping.

**Zombie Scenario: Season 8 (Upcoming Threat).** David, Erika and Gerard form a new team and set out to recruit the person who once blew up the Rex Labs (Yuri), tracking them to an abandoned munitions factory - where Douglas sends a hunter after them. Ritsuka is also dispatched to stop the party but fails. By Season 9 David is named among the heroes (with Soi and Jennifer) working to stop Douglas.

abilities.name: Zombie Scenario stat profile
abilities.description: Higher HP (+4) and higher reserve ammo (+2), but lower attack power (-2) and lower mobility (-3). Suited to survival rather than raw combat.

scenarios: Zombie Scenario: Season 5 - Third Report (hidden NPC supporting Soy)
Zombie Scenario: Season 7 - Rex Labs, Lowdown

weapons: Quad-barreled shotgun (seen in a Third Report cutscene protecting Soy)
Desert Eagle, Glock, M95, Destroyer, Minigun, Catapult (weapon icons shown on his page)
relatedCharacters: Gerard - Counter-Terrorist counterpart, former protege turned pursuer, later ally
Erika - rescued survivor he treats like a daughter
Norman - Vanguard financier who kidnapped Erika
Soy (Soi) - Aegis researcher he protects in Third Report
Douglas Jacob - the antagonist behind Erika's kidnapping
trivia: Appears as a guiding NPC in Behind, Threat, Panic Room and Illusion.
Appears as a hidden NPC supporting Soy in the Third Report chapter, revealing himself at the end.
A cutscene shows him wielding a Quad-barreled shotgun to protect Soy from three zombies.
His hidden-NPC message graphic is shared with Gerard.
Variants: Outlaw David (anarchist version) and Boss David Black (transcendence version).
